design: retrospective fixed before local fitting and opening test rows

sparc.selection: positive radius, observed speed and signed baryonic acceleration; all galaxies with usable rows
sparc.loss: mean per-galaxy mean squared log10 acceleration residual
sparc.btfr: outermost velocity proxy, photometric masses unavailable from rotation decomposition alone; report enclosed baryonic mass proxy separately
sparc.null: 10000 log-uniform a0 in [1e-12,1e-8] m/s²; compare best absolute log distance to three scales
sparc.external: Planck 2018 flat LCDM H0=67.4±0.5, OmegaL=.6847 fixed; separate sensitivity SH0ES 2022 H0=73.04±1.04; common H0 draw across all scales; conditional on fixed OmegaL

nuclear.scope: conditional single neutron f7/2 pairing with inert N=20 core; no claim of microscopic interaction
nuclear.test: Ca Z=20; same N and observables; terminal full shell excluded from E2
nuclear.model: E(n,v)=epsilon*n-G*(n-v)*(10-n-v)/4; excitation v=2 minus v=0; n=N-20
nuclear.baseline: train separate constant means for S2n and E2
nuclear.loss: joint unweighted MSE in MeV^2; report both channels and mass-error correlations; equal 2 parameters per model
nuclear.fit: least squares train, G>=0, freeze before test; no retuning
nuclear.measurements: AME2020 via NUBASE2020 ground state mass excess; first 2+ evaluated ENSDF levels; flag extrapolated masses; report covariance sensitivity
